category: Italian multi-hoster debrid with a 24-host list

free_tier.stated: None. The home page sells only a chat promo: 'CHAT PROMO: 365 DAYS - 21,90 euro', payable by credit card through WhatsApp or by Paysafecard/Bitcoin on request.

per_object_cap.stated: not stated: no per-file ceiling is published

retention.stated: not applicable: generated links are transient and nothing is stored

egress.terms: Vendor claims 'unlimited parallel downloads without waiting time' and publishes no byte allowance. Server-side counters are shown instead: 'Bandwidth consumption: 46,451.86 TB' across 4 servers.

interface_detail: Web application with a Telegram channel (@debriditalia) for announcements; no API, CLI or protocol endpoint is published on the reachable pages.
tooling: Browser only as far as the site documents; the Telegram channel carries announcements rather than a bot interface.
chaining: At EUR 1.83-1.96 per month of prepaid access it is the cheapest way to cover 24 European hosts, and it composes with JDownloader only insofar as the generated link is a plain HTTPS URL.

limits.value: no published allowance; a third-party reseller page sells 15 days / 2.90 EUR and 365 days / 23.90 EUR with no traffic figure attached

limits_note: The only limit language on the site is the claim of 'unlimited parallel downloads'; there is no fair-use paragraph, no daily host cap and no concurrency figure on the page a reader can reach.
binding_note: Nothing in the seven-kind vocabulary can be named from evidence: the vendor publishes no request rate, no byte allowance, no per-object cap and no concurrency figure, and the 4-server / 24-host shape is the only structural hint. Naming a kind here would be invention, so the honest entry is none plus the note that no counter is documented.

identity_cost.detail: Registration is required to buy; the signup form was not opened. The promo is transacted over WhatsApp, which is the only channel the vendor names for payment questions.

reliability_note: Four servers and an Italian company number (P.I. 02707310807) behind it; payment for the annual promo runs through a WhatsApp chat rather than a card form, so a failed payment has no self-service path.
confidence_note: Hosts (24), servers (4), users (94,587) and the EUR 21.90 / 365-day promo are vendor-stated and read today. The monthly ladder (30 days EUR 4.50, 365 days EUR 23.90) is third-party. A vendor price list, which the site does not publish in HTML, would raise this to documented.

evidence.proved: 'CHAT PROMO: 365 DAYS - 21,90 euro'; 'Number of servers: 4'; 'Supported hosters: 24'; 'Registered users: 94.587'; 'unlimited parallel downloads'; P.I. 02707310807
the price ladder '15 Tage für 2.9 EUR (5.8 EUR pro Monat)', '30 Tage für 4.5 EUR', '365 Tage für 23.9 EUR (1.96 EUR pro Monat)'

price_per_tb_month: EUR 4.50 per 30 days; EUR 1.83/month at the vendor's EUR 21.90 / 365-day chat promo
notes: This is the cheapest effective monthly price and it appears in none of the English comparison sites; the reason is language plus payment: the annual deal is sold in an Italian WhatsApp chat, not through a checkout. The 24-host list is roughly a third of AllDebrid's, so the low price buys fewer hosts rather than cheaper bytes. Two price routes disagree (vendor EUR 21.90/year vs reseller EUR 23.90/year); the conservative number is recorded in price_per_tb_month.
